task_types.label: Write tests
task_types.description: Write or improve automated tests, including important edge cases and failure paths.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Describe the behavior to test, expected outcomes, and important edge cases…

task_types.label: Write documentation
task_types.description: Create or revise clear prose documentation for a product, process, or technical concept.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Describe the audience, subject, required sections, and desired tone…

task_types.label: Research
task_types.description: Investigate a question and return methodical analysis supported by sources.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: State the research question, scope, source requirements, and desired output…

task_types.label: Generate code
task_types.description: Produce working code that follows the codebase conventions and passes existing tests.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Describe the code to build, interfaces, constraints, and acceptance tests…

task_types.label: Review code
task_types.description: Review code for correctness and actionable defects, citing specific files or lines.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Provide the code or PR context and the risks or requirements to review…

task_types.label: Refactor code
task_types.description: Restructure existing code while preserving its behavior and avoiding regressions.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Describe the code to refactor, behavior to preserve, and target structure…

task_types.label: Reasoning
task_types.description: Analyze a bounded question and explain the conclusion step by step.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Describe the question, constraints, and desired conclusion…

task_types.label: Complex reasoning
task_types.description: Solve a multi-step or high-context problem that requires deeper, methodical analysis.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Provide the full context, dependencies, constraints, and the decision or solution you need…

task_types.label: Create a plan
task_types.description: Create an ordered execution plan that covers dependencies, risks, and completion criteria.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Describe the objective, current state, constraints, dependencies, and deadline…

task_types.label: Review an artifact
task_types.description: Evaluate a non-code artifact against stated criteria and identify specific issues.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Provide the artifact, review criteria, and the decisions the review should support…

task_types.label: Summarize
task_types.description: Condense supplied material into a concise, accurate summary.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Provide the material and specify the audience, length, and facts to preserve…

task_types.label: Delegate to agents
task_types.description: Break a larger objective into executable subtasks and return a structured dispatch report.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Describe the objective, available agents or capabilities, constraints, and done criteria…

task_types.label: Escalate a problem
task_types.description: Route a difficult unresolved problem directly to the escalation tier for deeper analysis.
task_types.prompt_placeholder: Describe what has already been tried, why it failed, and the unresolved decision…
